svg.title: Chromosome 2 fusion schematic
svg.desc: Two acrocentric source chromosomes fuse at their short-arm telomeres. The dicentric and centromere-inactivation intermediates each retain one continuous chromosome body; the lower centromere becomes inactive. The final human chromosome 2 retains its functional centromere, short arm and long arm. Source schematic band order, source centromere positions, five source chromosome objects, and all original callout wording retained. Band lengths are illustration coordinates, not a measured cytogenetic map. Hollow purple active markers and a dashed inactive-site ring are diagram conventions.
